answer: Locks are recorded in relic, expire in basalt, and sonnet lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 122 aliases hence needs 63 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4175 identities would post 3560 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
